summary: Iteration 7 — Frontend-only verification of the 2 iteration_6 non-blocking improvements. BOTH IMPROVEMENTS VERIFIED PASSING. (1) DSP Share QR compression: with demo preset (5 outputs, Lab Gruppen LM 44), the QR IS NOW generated (share-dsp-qr count=1), share-dsp-qr-warning is absent (count=0), URL length = 1053 chars (vs 4940 uncompressed → ~4.7x reduction), URL starts with '/shared/dsp#preset=z' (gzip prefix). All 4 primary testids present: share-dsp-url, share-dsp-copy, share-dsp-download, share-dsp-qr, plus share-dsp-close. (2) Round-trip decode: navigating the extracted URL renders 'Preset DSP importado' with shared-dsp-badge='Solo lectura', shared-dsp-created showing model+5 outputs, and all 5 shared-dsp-output-{0..4} cards with correct Gain/HPF/LPF/Delay/EQ values (OUT A TOP L 5 bands, OUT B TOP R 4 bands, OUT C SUB L 2 bands, OUT D SUB R 2 bands, OUT E ...). (3) Malicious/empty payload rejection: '/shared/dsp#preset=zINVALID_GZIP_DATA', '/shared/dsp#preset=' (empty), and '/shared/dsp' (no hash) all render 'Enlace inválido' + shared-dsp-back button — NO crashes, no pageerrors. (4) Regression: /kiosk (kiosk-root=1, kiosk-panic-btn=1) and /settings (replay-tour-btn=1) unchanged. /dsp dsp-share-btn requires a loaded room (expected — with demo loaded it appears, without a room state it is gated).
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/shared-dsp/index.tsx L46-49 MAX_OUTPUTS/MAX_EQ_PER_OUTPUT caps are enforced AFTER decompression → an attacker could still submit a compressed blob whose gzip-decompressed size is huge (zip bomb). Consider adding a byte-limit on the decompressed size before JSON.parse (e.g. bail if bytes.length > 128 KiB). Non-blocking but a real DoS vector remains theoretically open.

src/pages/shared-dsp/index.tsx L34 uses `new Blob([bytes as BlobPart]).stream()` — the `as BlobPart` cast bypasses TS. Safer/cleaner: `new Blob([bytes.buffer])` or `new Response(bytes).body!`. Non-blocking.

src/components/soundmap/share-dsp-modal.tsx L60-65 useMemo captures ts=Date.now() only when outputs/dspModel change (same comment as iteration_6). If a user opens the modal, edits outside, and reopens, ts stays stable across re-opens of an unchanged preset. Minor UX/semantics issue.

src/components/soundmap/share-dsp-modal.tsx L108-119 copy() silently swallows the error via toast; no logging. If clipboard denials in production need diagnosis, consider console.warn(err) inside catch. Non-blocking.

src/components/soundmap/share-dsp-modal.tsx encodePreset async is awaited inside useEffect but there is no visible 'encoding…' state on the UI — when the modal first opens, the URL/QR area is blank for ~200-500ms. Minor UX polish opportunity (a spinner in that slot instead of the empty container). Non-blocking.
